title: Liber promissionum et praedictorum Dei (Book of God's Promises and Predictions) / «Книга обетований и предсказаний Божиих»
author: Quodvultdeus of Carthage (transmitted under Prosper's name)
genre: Typological exegesis / theology of history, apocalyptic
size: 3 parts + Dimidium temporis + Gloria sanctorum (c. 150 chapters); est. 45–55k words
edition: Braun, SC 101–102 (1964) and CCSL 60 (1976); public-domain text in PL 51 (under Prosper)
ru_evidence: Not in azbyka.ru author directory; ru.wikipedia 'Кводвультдеус' (wikitext checked) cites no translation; no Russian edition found
en_evidence: en.wikipedia lists only Braun SC; Open Library shows French and Italian only. English exists only for his creedal sermons (Finn, ACW 2004)
other_translations: French: Braun, SC 101–102 (1964). Italian: Città Nuova (1989); Libreria Editrice Vaticana (2002)
value: Written by Augustine's deacon, the exiled bishop of Carthage. It contains eyewitness notes on the Vandal conquest, Carthage's Caelestis temple, pagan cult, portents and Roman monuments, and is a key Augustinian theology of history. Used by historians of Vandal Africa, late paganism and apocalypticism.
ai_feasibility: high: plain Latin prose with dense biblical citation that is easy to verify; public-domain source. Contemporary allusions need historical notes.
pilot_unit: Part III (tempus gratiae), chs. 34–44 (incl. the Caelestis temple), plus Dimidium temporis; est. 10–12k words
